name: devpul
description: Serve the DevPul UI on 127.0.0.1: inspect Dart and Flutter HTTP calls, errors and events in your browser.

scripts.prepack: npm run build -w devpul-app --prefix .. && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.rmSync('ui',{recursive:true,force:true});f.cpSync('../app/dist','ui',{recursive:true});for(const x of ['CNAME','robots.txt','sitemap.xml','llms.txt','sw.js'])f.rmSync('ui/'+x,{force:true})"
